rails.vin: 10.8-13.2 V external adapter via J1 wire pads
consumers: U1 PVCC 31/32 + 18/19: 2 x 4 ohm BTL, 3.6 A at 12 V / 10 % THD, 4.0 A at 13.2 V (power.md table 3)
U1 AVCC 17: 20 mA typ, 35 mA max quiescent (SLOS708G 6.5)
rails.note: no regulator; U1 loss is listed under thermal_constraints

consumers: GAIN/SLV divider (5.6k to GND, R2 open: 20 dB master)
rails.note: internal to U1, not a board regulator; IGVDD < 200 uA (SLOS708G 6.5)

notes: output_net_names: provisional, from the TPA31xxD2 pin names; P2 must rename to its schematic nets and add the post-inductor speaker nets at the same 3 A

thermal_design_point: 1.5 W covers 8 ohm full power at 13.2 V (1.5 W) and 4 ohm music (0.8 W); 4 ohm continuous full-power sine is 3.0-4.2 W and is outside a 44x34 mm no-heatsink board (power.md section 4)
min_vias: applies to the pad-down TPA3118D2 (DAP); the TPA3116D2 (DAD) has no bottom pad
inductor: Isat >= 4 A, >= 1 uH at 7.5 A OC trip, DCR <= 30 mOhm
